whatsappMessage:
Hi Team M-karate dojo,

I noticed your karate dojo has stellar 4.9★ reviews across 154+ ratings in Kumhrar, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new student admissions and trial class bookings.

Maine aapke dojo ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, belt training programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/mkarate

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team M-karate dojo, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke dojo ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for parents looking for martial arts classes in Kumhrar, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact batch timings, actual dojo photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
